description: Implement draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 + RFC 8984 (JSCalendar) data types. Types only — no async. Structs: Calendar (id, name, description, color, sortOrder, isVisible, isSubscribed, shareWith, myRights, includeInAvailability), CalendarRights (7 booleans), IncludeInAvailability enum, CalendarEvent (full JSCalendar Event with JMAP additions: id, calendarIds, isDraft, isOrigin, utcStart, utcDue, baseEventId), RecurrenceRule, Participant, Alert, AlertTrigger, Location, CalendarEventNotification, ParticipantIdentity, query/filter types, capability structs, per-user property set. All camelCase serde. Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 + RFC 8984. Pattern: jmap-mail-types.
title: jmap-calendars-types: JSCalendar + JMAP Calendars data types
